authorization: User request (English translation): Organize the existing two-state structures into reliable control labels. This authorizes this separate structural-reference annotation version; frozen labels and scoring protocols are not replaced.
distance_score_definition: For identity-mapped C-alpha pairs within 15 A in either state, exclude sequence separation <2 in either state. Mean fraction of absolute distance differences below 0.5,1,2,4 A. A symmetric C-alpha-only adaptation inspired by lDDT, not the original all-atom lDDT implementation.
evaluation_policy: Only cases retaining both inherited positives and new stable references may be considered for later region evaluation. Two endpoints stay in one binding group; residues and overlapping windows must never be randomly split. No scoring folds or model results are generated here.
mapping: Use sequence/experimental-entity correspondence, never structure-superposition correspondence to reassign residue identities. Require amino-acid identity, one-to-one coordinates, finite C-alpha, occupancy >=0.95 and a unique model-1 C-alpha.

method_source.use: Local distance preservation concept, 15 A radius and four tolerances; this project adds symmetric neighborhoods, C-alpha restriction, local RMSD, DSSP, identity/coverage gates and segment requirements.

negative_semantics: Locally preserved structured segment in the two observed experimental states, under the registered geometric criteria. Not an author-asserted universal non-switching region.
positive_policy: Carry over all 124 previously accepted positive endpoint-residue rows exactly; do not add geometry-derived positives or silently repair historical coordinates.
review_policy: Mechanical validation and separately implemented geometric verification are required; formal task closure still requires independent review.
scope: Existing experimental structure pairs only; retrospective development annotation, without model scores or new model evaluation.
source_ensemble_policy: Require single-model original experimental structures for new negative annotations. Multi-model structures require ensemble comparison and remain unlabelled by this builder.
threshold_basis: Conservative operational annotation choices fixed before running this builder; not universal fold-switch thresholds and not optimized against positive labels or model performance. Report strict sensitivity without selecting a winning variant.
